'''2012 Canadian Nationals Peter Tenneson DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Peter Tenneson]] at [[2012 Canadian Nationals]] (Nationals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]
* '''Username:''' patmagroin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Nationals
